name: ProWebExp – Network Members Sync
author: Saubhik M

sections.description:
ProWebExp – Network Members Sync helps network administrators keep user membership and roles aligned across selected sites in a WordPress Multisite network.

Features:

  • Automatically propagate newly registered users to selected sites.
  • Synchronize site memberships.
  • Synchronize standard and custom roles.
  • Support the WooCommerce Customer role when it exists on the source site.
  • Optionally create missing custom roles on target sites.
  • Bulk synchronize existing users in batches.
  • Optional synchronized removal of site membership.
  • Network Admin settings.
  • Enqueued admin CSS and JavaScript.
  • Nonce and capability checks for administrative actions.

WordPress Multisite uses a network-wide user account with site-specific membership and roles. This plugin synchronizes the site membership and role assignments without creating duplicate network user accounts.

Important

Custom-role creation is disabled by default. Enabling it copies the source role’s capabilities to the target site. Review custom-role permissions before enabling this option.

Synchronizing removals removes site membership only. It does not delete the network user account.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Network activate the plugin.
  3. Open Network Admin > ProWebExp – Network Members Sync.
  4. Configure the source and target sites.
  5. Save the settings.
  6. Use “Sync Existing Users Now” for users that already exist.
